mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 3-month moving average compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as capital costs fall across the market.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points from the prior month signals deteriorating labor market health, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as revenue growth expectations fall across sectors.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for two consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 110 indicates manufacturing output contraction, reducing corporate capacity utilization and earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during supply-side stress.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 110, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained monthly growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 100,000 signals robust labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth > 100,000 for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate above 5.0% signals restrictive monetary policy, increasing borrowing costs and reducing corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate manufacturing output contraction with labor market resilience, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as growth risks escalate.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises simultaneously for two consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales (RSAFS) above 370,000 million dollars indicates strong consumer demand, supporting corporate revenue growth and profit margins, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 370000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.
